description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830118 (23/0477)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, cadastral maps, and property encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land settlement and title registration processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
